content.title: Ford’s EV Sales Plunge. Now We Know What the Tax Credit Meant.
content.summary: Electric-vehicle sales are going to finish the year terribly, if  Ford Motor’s  October results are any indication.  Monday, Ford released monthly sales for the U.S., saying it sold 175,584 vehicles, up about 2% year over year.  Coming into October, Ford’s U.S. sales were up about 7% year to date.

content.title: Ford U.S. sales rise 1.6% in October as truck demand offsets EV drop
